agent.name: Aumo
agent.mandate: Put idle stablecoins to work in tokenized real-world-asset yield, within on-chain guardrails, and prove every move.

venues.name: Pendle PT-USDG (fixed, Oct 2026)
venues.note: Pendle PT-USDG market 0xcFB506cb34DD340e80d3dF8764182a5187636032 (Router V4, PT oracle 0x5542be50420E88dd7D5B4a3D488FA6ED82F6DAc2), SY 0x1F336F899f77B084133bc14a81170837ED618D1b, PT 0x9a09a9E491DB3dd8Ada5B1B889991AC9Ad5fd362. Fixed yield to maturity 2026-10-29. APY, TVL, and exit liquidity are now read live on-chain each cycle via feed.source=pendle (implied APY from the PT oracle, reserves from the market); the static values here are only a fallback if that read fails. Peg to USDG measured live from the USDT0/USDG v3 pool (pegSource); pegVerified is EARNED from a TWAP each cycle, never hardcoded.

venues.name: USDG/USDT0 LP (Uniswap v3)
venues.note: Full-range USDG/USDT0 liquidity on Uniswap v3 (0.01% pool 0x0cBe0dBE1400e57f371a38BD3b9bC80F7C3676dA, fee 100, tickSpacing 1). Adapter 0x483aC413349951b34bFC9a8f0311A70F35e80F38 deployed + allowlisted on mainnet 2026-08-22, 3-pass Kensho-audited, fork-verified. The position is valued LIVE on-chain each cycle (adapter.balanceOf via the pool's peg-band-clamped sqrt price plus fees); peg to USDG is measured live (pegSource), pegVerified EARNED from a TWAP. APY is now read LIVE via feed.source=univ3lp (annualized growth of the pool's feeGrowthGlobal between hourly readings); the apyBps here is only a cold-start fallback until a full window accrues. TVL/liquidity are the pool's real reserves. Base trading fees on a pegged pair are thin, so until X Layer's RWA liquidity incentives land (eligible-asset list drops 2026-08-24) the agent correctly holds this near zero — deliberate, not idle; PENDING 2026-08-24 incentives to make it competitive.

venues.name: Spark Savings USDT (spUSDT)
venues.note: Spark Savings USDT (spUSDT) ERC-4626 vault 0xc358c90D32375721Cb3924320Fdc2F8B694347Ca on X Layer (asset()==USDT0, so no swap leg). Sky/Spark savings via OKX Onchain Earn, flexible redemption, ~3.2% quoted APR. Aumo adapter (Erc4626Adapter) 0xd14f133D2ad6a7CF32cdaB5166eC95d58048fC10 deployed + fork-proven 2026-09-11. underlying tagged USDT0 so the correlated-underlying cap groups it with Aave (balances the USDG side). kind lending = base-asset-denominated yield position like aUSDT0, no separate peg. apyBps 320 is a documented fallback from the Spark/OKX quote; a live erc4626 growth feed (convertToAssets delta) is the follow-up to score it on real yield. GATED until the pool owner runs setVenueAllowed(adapter, true); venueAllowed was false at time of writing, so the agent will list but not allocate until then.

plan.summary: Hold. No move improves the risk-adjusted position within a cautious regime and moderate appetite. Liquidity: All venues have worstCaseExitSharePct far below 25%, so no exit-size risk. Macro: High utilization on Aave v3 suggests holding additional idle to mitigate potential liquidity risk.

verdicts.note: All venues have worstCaseExitSharePct far below 25%, so no exit-size risk.
